q: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password." A reset link will be emailed to you, but please note that it expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month. You can save 20% with annual billing.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: According to our FAQ, the Team plan costs $8 per user per month, so the total would be $40 for 5 people. We offer a 20% discount if you choose an annual plan. For other billing questions, please contact our support team.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be fully refunded within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your Plus plan order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: According to our policy, you can get a full refund within 14 days of your purchase. Since it has been three weeks, I cannot verify your eligibility from the FAQ. Would you like to send an email to support@example.com to ask about processing a refund?

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: According to the FAQ, there is no Linux desktop app, but you can use the web app on any modern browser. Would you like to know how to get started with the web app?

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later to run. If you are on Android 11, you can use the web app on a mobile browser.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app requires a constant internet connection to function. However, the mobile and desktop apps do support offline usage and will sync when you reconnect. If you need offline capabilities, I recommend downloading one of the apps.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export to choose between Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can restore deleted notes within 30 days by opening the Trash folder, selecting the note, and clicking "Restore". Since 30 days have passed, you will not see it there anymore. If you need further assistance, please contact support@example.com for a ticket.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: I don't have that information in my knowledge base. You can email support@example.com to open a ticket, and we will reply within one business day.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: According to our pricing, the maximum file size for attachments is 25 MB on the Free plan.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: You will keep your Plus features until the end of your current billing period. To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, and they are encrypted both at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: According to the FAQ, we reply within one business day. Email us at support@example.com if you need faster assistance.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20% on all plans.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use 3 devices.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインイン画面で「パスワードを忘れる」をクリックしてください。P30分で期限切れになり、メールでリセットリンクを送信します。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: Assuming you are referring to the third time within the last 30 days, deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore" to get it back.
